classifications.rationale: The President presently continues existing export-control rules, orders, licenses, and other administrative actions while directly limiting the maximum fine and making a specified civil penalty inapplicable. Those legal consequences occur through the segment itself, notwithstanding its additional delegations and administrative provisions.
classifications.evidence: the maximum fine which may be imposed under section 387.1(a) (1) of Title 15, Code of Federal Regulation, shall not exceed $10,000
